note: Chapter 1 keys the short corner on 'From a short corner', Messi's pass on 'Messi passes', the first touch on 'Enzo Fernández', the shimmy on 'He shimmies', the strike on 'curls it' and the goal on 'into the top corner'. Chapter 2 keys the hip sway on 'Enzo sways' and the drag inside on 'slips past'. Read 'Fernández' as fer-NAN-des, 'Gutiérrez' as goo-tee-EH-res, 'Ochoa' as oh-CHO-ah.

chapters.label: The curler, live
chapters.text: Qatar, 2022, the World Cup. Argentina lead Mexico late on. From a short corner, Messi passes to Enzo Fernández. He shimmies, and curls it... into the top corner!

chapters.label: The shimmy
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Gutiérrez closes him down. Enzo sways his hips one way, then slips past the other way.

chapters.label: The curl
chapters.text: Right foot. The ball bends across goal, past the leaping Ochoa, into the far corner. Argentina win two-nil!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: open your body, and strike with the inside of your foot. Curl the ball towards the far corner, away from the keeper's reach!
